error.clock: The license clock kept by the installation cannot be read
error.instance: The lease is issued for the installation {instance}, not for this one
error.lease: The signed document is not a lease: {reason}
error.not_started: The license module has not started yet
error.older: This lease was issued at {issued}, before the installed one ({installed}); an older lease never replaces a newer one
error.signature: The lease is not signed with the license key: {reason}
error.stored: The stored lease is not a signed text: {value}

license.expired: The lease expired on {expiresAt} and its grace ended on {graceEndsAt}; the installation is read-only until a new lease is installed
license.expiring: The lease expired on {expiresAt}; everything keeps working until {graceEndsAt}, then the installation turns read-only
license.product_unlisted: The lease does not list the product {product}; its modules are read-only and its data is kept
